name: Shiokan Room e Youkoso!!
original_name: しおかんルームへようこそ！！
source:
When you wake up, you find yourself trapped in a white room with neither windows nor doors.
There, you encounter "Shiokan", a mysterious can that loves hamsters.
Interact with Shiokan to raise your affinity level and escape the room!

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/siokan.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
当你醒来时，发现自己被困在一间既没有窗户也没有房门的纯白房间里。
在那里，你遇到了一只酷爱仓鼠的神秘罐头——“盐罐”。
与盐罐互动提升好感度，设法逃出这间密室吧！

[译自[url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/siokan.html]官方网站[/url]]
